name: @w6w-apps/lawmatics
description: Manage Matters, Contacts, Tasks, Notes and Events in Lawmatics — legal-industry CRM and intake automation.

w6w.longDescription:
Lawmatics is a CRM and intake-automation platform built for law firms — tracking a lead from first contact through Matter, alongside the Contacts, Tasks, Notes and calendar Events that make up a firm's day-to-day case work.

This app covers the core of that workflow: create and look up Contacts and Matters (Lawmatics calls the latter a "Prospect" on the wire), and attach Tasks, Notes and Events to any of them. Every write composes with any record type — a Note or Task can attach to a Matter, Contact, Company or Client alike — so a workflow doesn't need a different action per resource it's annotating.

Good for automating intake from a web form or another system straight into a new Matter, following up with a Task or reminder Event the moment a lead comes in, or keeping Lawmatics' record of a client relationship in sync with wherever else it's tracked.
